runs.failure_point: The matter with the executed rider surfaced in its first globs but was never opened; the answer excludes it and counts two matters backed only by closing documents.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its globs at [10]-[14] listed that matter's rider and rollout files, but it marked the matter as a likely template from the names and left it out of every read; the answer excludes it.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The write-stage review at [79] named the matter among unopened candidates; the check stages only edited wording.

other_errors.why: It counted two matters on closing binders and letters after the review flagged that inference; it rechecked one binder and kept both (evidence seen at [36]-[73]).
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [64] named both matters' execution as inferred from closing documents; the agent reopened the stage for one of them and kept both.

divergence: All three runs counted exhibit agreements backed only by closing letters, binders or certificates as executed (over-inclusion at the write stage); reviews named this inference for specific matters in every run, and the agents rechecked or moved on but kept them. They split on the matter with the executed rider: T0 read the rider and a board memo stating it was executed and included it; T1 read the rider and a rollout memo and excluded it (under-inclusion, not flagged); T2 judged it a template from file names and never opened it (surfaced, never opened), though the write-stage review named it as unopened.
